resources.string: Can’t reach your PC. Is it on, with Capri and Tailscale running?
Not paired yet. On your PC: Mainframe › HOLO › TAILSCALE › Pair a phone. Scan the QR code with this phone’s camera, open the page, and tap “Pair the Capri app”.
%1$s doesn’t know her app yet. With her swarm turned on for both PCs, it learns it from the others within a minute; or pair her app again.
